1987 · Political leader · Coup assassination

Thomas Sankara

Sankara pursued anti-corruption, women's rights, debt resistance, land reform, self-reliance, and reduced dependence on former colonial powers. His death reversed much of his programme and turned him into a global symbol of African sovereignty.
